retrievalProfile.description: A multi-colored geometric layout featuring a circular halftone portrait framed by bold primary and secondary color blocks with heavy display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into a top horizontal header and a main body section. The body features a large central circular aperture containing a high-contrast halftone portrait, surrounded by vertical and horizontal color fields. The header contains oversized, tightly-spaced lowercase typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular central focus against rectilinear color blocks
High-contrast halftone texture vs. flat solid color fields
Oversized header type balanced by small metadata text
Warm-toned portrait vs. cool-toned surrounding blocks
coreInvariants: Halftone screen texture on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait within a circle, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular portrait serves as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy top-left typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top-left text, moves down to the central portrait, then scans the smaller metadata in the top-right and side margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the design is densely packed with color blocks and large-scale elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright blue header and side bar, salmon-pink central background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep forest green vertical bar on the left.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and orange tones within the halftone portrait.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all blocks with a mid-tone, warm-tinted portrait for contrast.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'c' and 'l' are tightly kerned to overlap or touch
Circular counters in 'd' and 'e' are minimized
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy condensed sans-serif for impact paired with wide, spaced-out serif for technical details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, lowercase display feel.
Matches the expanded serif metadata style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square layout with a bright blue top header and a salmon-pink main body. Add a dark green vertical bar on the far left and a purple bar on the far right. In the center, place a large circular halftone portrait of a smiling man in a suit, tinted with yellow and orange tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add oversized, condensed lowercase sans-serif text in the top-left header, using a yellow-to-red color split. Add small, wide-tracked uppercase serif text in white to the top-right header.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait inside a perfect circle?
Is the main display text lowercase and touching?
Are the color blocks solid and flat?
Does the portrait have a visible halftone dot pattern?

adjustableVariables: Width of the side color bars
postGenerationChecks: Verify the halftone effect is visible in the portrait
Ensure the top header text is lowercase
Check that the color blocks are perfectly rectangular
Confirm the circular mask is centered and sharp
Ensure metadata text is small and wide-spaced
recipe.reuseFormula: Square Layout + Top Header Block + Central Circular Halftone Portrait + Bold Condensed Lowercase Type + Primary Color Blocking.
